name: CBNBC 2015
information: The entrance fee for this competition will be: For competitiors €8 per day or €15 for the weekend. Competitiors only registered for 3x3 get a €3 discount. Entrance fee for guests will be €2. There's a limit of 60 competitiors.Sleeping is available at the venue for a small price, contact Tiemen for more info.
